ctx.x: That's one of those family bands. I forget what they called it. I think they were an Imperial Band or something like that. And Paul Barnes was playing around there. Pullo Barnes, you know, you'd have one of those French nicknames, even if his last name was Barnes. He was from New Orleans, I remember playing, but mainly alto. I remember one of those fast-fingering alto players that you used to get then. And I guess they'd get them in the first.
Yeah. There were a lot of them. Well, of course, you hear Weedhoff and Jimmy Dorsey, even. I mean, that kind of fingering. And Al Galladero, it tripped his hat to Weedhoff.
